response: What makes me mad? Too many things to list, but in general I get frustrated when people are inconsiderate, when injustice occurs, or when things don't get done the way they should.

When people are not logical or consistent in their thinking, that makes me mad. When people are dishonest or lack integrity, that makes me mad. When people try to take advantage of others and put their own interests before others, that makes me mad.
Stupidity, injustice, and lazy people make me mad.
When people are unkind or unjust.
Injustice, unfairness, and hypocrisy make me mad.

When people are inconsiderate or disrespectful, it makes me mad. When I see injustice or people taking advantage of others, that makes me mad. When I hear of institutionalized racism or sexism, that makes me mad.
Injustice, inequality, and privilege are things that make me mad. When people feel entitled to act in a manner that disadvantages others or puts down marginalised communities, it's infuriating to me.

When people are disrespectful or dishonest, it makes me mad. When I see injustice or inequality, it makes me mad. When people are reckless and irresponsible, it makes me mad. When people don't take responsibility for their actions, it makes me mad.
Injustice, inequality, and hypocrisy make me mad. When people are treated unfairly or when systems are set up to advantage some and disadvantage others, I get angry.
I get mad when I see injustice, especially when it is directed at those who can't defend themselves. I also get angry when people are close-minded and refuse to listen to other perspectives.

When people are unkind or disrespectful, that makes me mad. When situations are unfair or people don't take responsibility for their actions, I can get angry. Also, when people try to make me feel bad about myself, that makes me mad.

Injustice, cruelty, and inequality make me mad. I get angry when people act with prejudice or discrimination, and when innocent people are harmed. I also get angered when powerful people and institutions fail to take responsibility for their actions, or when they try to oppress, control or take advantage of others.
Ignorance, injustice, and cruelty make me mad.
Injustice, cruelty, and ignorance make me mad.
I get mad when people are dishonest or unkind.
Injustice and inequality make me mad. When people are treated unfairly or denied basic rights, it drives me crazy.
I get mad when people are racist, sexist, or otherwise discriminate against others. I also get mad when people are unkind or dishonest.
I get mad when people are unkind or inconsiderate, when there is injustice or inequality, and when people don't take responsibility for their actions.
Injustice and inequality make me mad. Seeing people take advantage of others, or unfairly treated makes me angry.
When people are unkind, inconsiderate, or dishonest makes me mad.
